concerns.text: FR-001/SC-005 require Band Gap and Formation Energy from OQMD and Thermal Conductivity from AFLOW, but T002 fetches matbench_expt_gap, matbench_mp_e_form, and boltztrap_mp via matminer — none are OQMD/AFLOW sources, and boltztrap_mp is electronic (not thermal) transport. No task covers FR-001 as written; either the spec must be amended to the matminer sources or tasks must fetch OQMD/AFLOW.

NFR-002 requires graceful handling of fetch failures with partial results saved, but T002 mandates a fail-loudly loader ('raise — never fall back… No try/except'). As written, no task can satisfy NFR-002's partial-results requirement for the download step.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all) vs contracts/dataset.schema.yaml and data-model.md MaterialsDataset
concerns.text: The MaterialsDataset entity / dataset.schema.yaml (dataset_id, source_url, property_name, n_samples, n_train, n_val, n_test, features, target, checksum) is never exercised: T002 writes an ad-hoc <id>_metadata.json with a different field set (n_samples_original/n_samples_used, no split counts or features). No task produces an artifact conforming to this contract.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all) vs plan.md Data-Model Mapping / data-model.md Data Flow step 3
concerns.text: Plan and data-model specify trained model artifacts saved under results/models/, but no task saves or verifies model artifacts. Either add a task or the plan element is uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all) vs constitution.md Data Hygiene / Principle V
concerns.text: Constitution requires every file under data/ checksummed in state/projects/PROJ-737-...yaml artifact_hashes and updated_at updates. No task records checksums into the project state file; T002 only writes local metadata JSON.

No task creates the pinned requirements.txt at projects/.../code/; T011 only references 'the pinned requirements.txt' in documentation. Add creation/pinning of requirements.txt to a task (e.g., T001 or T009).

Path convention diverges from the plan: tasks write all deliverables to data/results/ while plan/data-model specify results/ (e.g., results/uq_methods.csv, results/sensitivity_conformal.csv vs data/results/sensitivity_report.csv). Not a coverage gap per se, but the plan's named artifacts (sensitivity_conformal.csv, metrics_<dataset_id>.csv) have no matching task output names — align so each plan-named artifact is produced by a task.
